CheckTitle: Ensure Changes to Audit Policy Settings Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod with Basic Auth (Connection page): audit data for Audit Policies
Description: Audit policies that record changes to material Fusion configuration should stay enabled, and any change to them should be reviewed.
Risk: Disabling an audit policy, changing a setting and re-enabling the policy hides unauthorised configuration changes.
AuditProcedure: Tools > Audit Reports with Product = Audit Policies for the review period.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Example: control 60019.

Steps: Re-enable the policy (Setup and Maintenance > Manage Audit Policies).
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

DefaultValue: Changes to audit policies are always recorded.
Notes: Tested by the tool from the Fusion pod. Could not complete (MANUAL) until the pod connection works and the audit API is confirmed.
